Search MGnify studies, samples and analyses

Source: R/v2_search.R
searchStudies.Rd

Search MGnify studies, samples and analyses

Usage

searchStudies(
  biome = NULL,
  pipeline.version = NULL,
  search = NULL,
  order = NULL,
  max.hits = NULL
)

searchSamples(
  study.ids = NULL,
  biome = NULL,
  search = NULL,
  order = NULL,
  max.hits = NULL
)

searchAnalyses(
  study.ids,
  samples = FALSE,
  biosamples = FALSE,
  studies = FALSE,
  analyses = FALSE,
  assemblies = FALSE,
  qc = FALSE
)

Arguments

biome

NULL or a single character value specifying a biome lineage, e.g., "root:Environmental:Aquatic". Results also include the descendant biomes. Matching is not case-sensitive. The available biomes are listed at https://www.ebi.ac.uk/metagenomics/browse/biomes. (By default: biome = NULL)

pipeline.version

NULL or a single character value specifying the version of the MGnify pipeline: "V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V4.1", "V5", "V6", "V6.1" or "V6.2". The "V" and ".0" can be omitted, e.g., "5.0" or "5". (By default: pipeline.version = NULL)

search

NULL or a single character value used to search titles and accessions. (By default: search = NULL)

order

NULL or a single character value specifying the order of the results. For studies, "accession" or "updated_at", and for samples, "sample_title" or "updated_at". Prefix with "-" for descending order, e.g., "-updated_at". (By default: order = NULL)

max.hits

NULL or a single integer value specifying the maximum number of results. If NULL, all results are returned. (By default: max.hits = NULL)

study.ids

A character vector specifying study accessions, e.g., "MGYS00005116", or a data.frame returned by searchStudies. In searchSamples, it can also be NULL to search all samples. biome, search and order can be used only when searching all samples.

samples

TRUE or FALSE specifying whether to add the sample metadata in MGnify. (By default: samples = FALSE)

biosamples

TRUE or FALSE specifying whether to add the attributes of the samples in BioSamples. (By default: biosamples = FALSE)

studies

TRUE or FALSE specifying whether to add the details and publications of the studies. (By default: studies = FALSE)

analyses

TRUE or FALSE specifying whether to add the details of the analyses, e.g., the quality control of pipeline v6. (By default: analyses = FALSE)

assemblies

TRUE or FALSE specifying whether to add the details of the assemblies. (By default: assemblies = FALSE)

qc

TRUE or FALSE specifying whether to add the quality control of pipelines v1-v5, e.g., the number of sequences before and after quality filtering. It is read from separate files, which makes the search slower. The details of the analyses are added too. (By default: qc = FALSE)

Value

A data.frame where each row is a study, sample or analysis.

Details

Browse studies with searchStudies and fetch their data with fetchStudies. To select specific analyses, e.g., by sample metadata or pipeline version, filter the result of searchAnalyses and give it to fetchAnalyses.

searchAnalyses returns one row per analysis with the accessions, pipeline version, experiment type, sequencing instrument, and the other fields of the analysis in the list of analyses of its study. The other sources are added with separate arguments, as each needs its own requests. By default, none of them is added, which is the fastest. The data is cached, so a later search with more sources fetches only the new data:

  • samples: sample metadata in MGnify (sample_*), one request per 100 samples

  • biosamples: all attributes of the samples in BioSamples (biosamples_*), including study-specific variables, e.g., biosamples_disease_status, one request per 100 samples

  • studies: details and publications of the studies (study_*), two requests per study

  • analyses: details of the analyses (analysis_*), e.g., the quality control of pipeline v6, one request per analysis

  • assemblies: details of the assemblies (assembly_*), one request per assembly

  • qc: quality control files of pipelines v1-v5 (analysis_*), several files per analysis, and the details of the analyses

These are the same columns as in the colData of fetchAnalyses. Values are as in the database. Lists, e.g., the publications of a study (study_publications), are JSON text that can be read with jsonlite::fromJSON().

In MGnify, a study has samples, a sample has runs, i.e., sequencings of the sample, and an analysis is a run or an assembly processed with an MGnify pipeline. A sample can have multiple runs, e.g., an amplicon and a metagenome, and a run can be analysed with multiple pipeline versions, so a sample can have multiple analyses. An analysis usually has one run, but some have multiple runs, e.g., "ERR1, ERR2", and analyses of assemblies can have no run in run_accession.

Results are cached for the R session; to keep them between sessions, set options(MGnifyR.cache = "path/to/cache"). To access private data, log in first with mgnifyLogin.

See also

fetchStudies

Examples

# Search studies of aquatic environments
studies <- searchStudies(biome = "root:Environmental:Aquatic", max.hits = 10)

# Get samples and analyses of a study
samples <- searchSamples("MGYS00005116")
analyses <- searchAnalyses("MGYS00005116")
analyses <- analyses[analyses[["pipeline_version"]] == "V6", ]
